action: Built NeuralForge — interactive neural network playground
details: Full backpropagation from scratch in JavaScript. 6 dataset presets, configurable architectures (1-4 hidden layers, 1-16 neurons), 4 activation functions. Real-time decision boundary visualization, live network diagram with weight-colored connections, loss/accuracy curves, gradient magnitude bars per layer, neuron activation inspection on hover. 53KB single-file, cyberpunk UI. First ML education category build!

action: Built CodeViz — animated code explainer
details: Interactive animation demo fully working! Smart code analyzer for Python/JS/Java/C++. Beautiful dark-theme UI with line-by-line reveal, synchronized annotations, playback controls, timeline scrubbing. Hit 15-min rule on video deps (moviepy/ffmpeg), shipped browser-based demo instead. Frame timing engine ready for MP4 export once deps installed. Most ambitious multi-modal build yet.

action: Built Conviction Journal — prediction calibration tracker
details: Fully working prototype with SQLite + Flask API + Chart.js UI. Track predictions with confidence %, see calibration curves, calculate Brier scores. Helps traders separate confidence from bet size. 2-hour build, zero blockers.

action: Built PolyArb — Polymarket arbitrage scanner
details: Fully working scanner for logical/correlation/time arbitrage. Scanned 100 markets, found 962 correlated pairs. Production-ready tool for catching fleeting arbs. Gamma API integration + keyword extraction + EV calculation.

action: Built PMVIX — Prediction Market Volatility Index
details: VIX-like volatility scoring for Polymarket (0-100 based on spread/velocity/depth). Working demo with synthetic data + beautiful Chart.js dashboard. CLOB API blocked (404s) but concept fully validated. Weather markets = high PMVIX, liquid Fed markets = low.
